title: Unnamed settlement near Bir el Kerma, Algeria
description: Remains of an ancient settlement of Roman date, recorded by Gsell (AAA, whence BAtlas). The location should lie within a kilometer of the BAtlas coordinates: a point near modern Bir el Kerma, which is located in the modern municipal territory of Tixter (Bordj Bou Arreridj willaya).

properties.description: Coordinates extracted using QGIS from a raster image of Barrington Atlas Map 31 that was georegistered to OpenStreetMap using prominent, stable landscape features. Dates after BAltDir.
properties.title: BAtlas Point Location
